# Copilot & Cursor Agent Instructions

For any audit, bug-fix, or refactoring work in this repository:
1. Always read and strictly follow `docs/audit/WORKFLOW.md`.
2. Read the assigned finding from `docs/audit/tracker.md`.
3. Never read, print, or edit `.env*` files.
4. Never modify files outside this frontend repository.
5. Work exclusively on branch `audit-fixes` (or `fix/<ID>`).
